notes.note: #2932 part 2: session-api.md gained a description of the structured Claude ask reason under respondToRequest (which asks always prompt, the claudeAsk payload field, and the compound-command and reworded-text limits). The ADR cites the session API only as the current orchestration surface; its superseded-flag and retained-decision statements do not concern approval grants and still hold.

#2932 part 2: the Claude adapter now hands the SDK a spawnClaudeCodeProcess (claude-code-spawn.ts) whose stdout passes through a tap (claude-permission-frames.ts) that records each can_use_tool request's decision_reason_type, classifier_approvable, decision_reason_code and requires_user_interaction by request_id; canUseTool takes the record by options.requestId and publishes it as claudeAsk on request.opened, and a missing record counts as an escalation. Rewrote the page for it: added the structured-reason section and checked each bullet against claudeAskEscalates in tool-request-preview.ts and its unit cases (every reason type, other with and without the ordinary text, classifierApprovable, null), against the adapter tests that push real 2.1.278-shaped frames through the tap (Bash safetyCheck, rule, subcommandResults, sandboxOverride and other prose prompt under a Bash grant and under autoApprove '*'; ordinary Bash, MCP, WebFetch and Edit asks are answered; a missing record prompts), and against the real-SDK test claude-code-spawn.sdk.test.ts (option keys carry no reason type; requestId equals the frame request_id; exit error parity). Replaced the 'does not cover' paragraph and the edit safety-check paragraph, which are no longer true. The 256-record and 8 MiB bounds match MAX_RECORDED_PERMISSION_ASKS and MAX_PERMISSION_FRAME_BYTES. The frame shapes and reason texts were read in the bundled CLI binary, not captured live, and the page says so. PowerShell wrapping its ordinary ask in subcommandResults is likewise a binary read.

#2932 part 2: vitest-resource-manifest.mjs gained one process-heavy entry, src-server/providers/__tests__/claude-code-spawn.sdk.test.ts, which lets the real Agent SDK launch a Node stand-in for the Claude CLI.
